import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicates
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Fix island label variant (leading/trailing spaces)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    
    # Fix out of range body_mass_g (3625000 should be 3625)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].apply(lambda x: x/1000 if pd.notna(x) and x > 6500 else x)
    
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric if needed
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Convert year to numeric if needed
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Count penguins by island
    island_counts = df.groupby('island').size().to_dict()
    return island_counts
